title: LearnPuppy
one_liner: A local tutor that keeps what you learn in a knowledge graph and quizzes you before you forget it.
note: Runs on your machine and drives the claude, codex and agy CLIs you already have logged in.

media.caption: Sample data from the demo build.

title: Deskpost
one_liner: A support inbox you host yourself: shared queue, threads, internal notes, email in and out.
note: Customers can write in by email or from an embeddable widget. No paid services needed to run it.

media.caption: Sample data from the demo build. The UI still shows its old name, SendDesk.

title: bunfiiliate
one_liner: Open-source affiliate tracking and commission engine with a double-entry ledger.
note: The click path never touches the database, and every cent that moves is a ledger entry.

title: Kestrel
one_liner: A terminal workspace that runs many coding agents in git worktrees, locally or on a VPS.
note: Built to replace an Electron IDE that sat at about 2 GB of RAM with a handful of agents open.

media.caption: Design render of the workspace screen, not a live capture.

title: Beacon
one_liner: Control plane that runs scrapers and converters on home PCs and delivers their output to the content hubs.
note: Workers only talk to a local agent, the agent only runs a fixed list of commands, and every user write is audited.

media.caption: Local build with mock data and made-up source names.

title: ImageHub
one_liner: Content backend that imports scraped comics and galleries, stores them in R2 and pushes them out to many sites.
note: A Go rewrite of a Python service. I wrote most of the commits.

title: OctopusHub
one_liner: The Python content hub that ImageHub grew out of: ingest, store, distribute to domains over SSH.
note: Team codebase. My part was the video distribution and trimming work.
